reference_structure.reason: Published, peer-reviewed slab. The whole-slab density estimator reads 2.13 g/cm3 because the rough passivated surface layers count as full volume on a 12.6 A slab; trimming 2-4 A per face reads 2.71-2.78, and the same trimming moves the admitted SiO2 reference out of its own window (2.34-2.47 vs 2.20 +/- 0.10), so the estimator, not the structure, is out of calibration for thin slabs.
